Shar, Mistress of the Night Cookies were first introduced during [[Midwinter Festival]] in 2013. == 2025 - Current == {{Consumable | picdesc = Shar, Mistress of the Night Cookie (2025).png | acquired = [[Flurry (NPC)|Flurry ]] | location = [[Hall of Heroes]], Eberron | turnin = [[Snowpeaks Festival]]: {{SnowpeaksIngredient | ing_Bronze = 10 }} | minlevel = 1 | bind = {{Bind|no}} | effect = [[Invisibility, Mass]] - Duration: 15 minutes (CL: 15) | durability = 5 | material = Flesh | hardness = 0 | cost = 5 pp | weight = 0.01 lbs | description = Gingerbread cookie baked into the shape of Shar's holy symbol.
